# ARTS Outpatient

> > ARTS Outpatient (Absolute Recovery Therapeutic Solutions) provides intensive outpatient programs (IOP) and partial hospitalization programs (PHP) for addiction treatment and dual diagnosis mental health services across Southern California.

ARTS operates multiple treatment centers in the San Fernando Valley, including locations in Thousand Oaks and Canoga Park, offering evidence-based addiction recovery programs with comprehensive insurance coverage options. Founded by clinical leaders including John Sullivan (CADC II), Kendall Blackford, and Dr. Lucille Thomas, ARTS specializes in outpatient substance abuse treatment and co-occurring mental health disorders.
